# SoundEngg Full Technical Reference & Architecture Documentation

> Comprehensive technical specification, acoustic formulas, tool documentation, and knowledge base index for SoundEngg — the professional offline acoustic workstation for live sound reinforcement and system engineering.

---

## 1. Executive Overview

- **Application Name:** SoundEngg (SoundEngg: RTA & Audio Utility)
- **Domain:** https://www.soundengg.com
- **Web App Console:** https://www.soundengg.com/app.html
- **Founder & Lead Systems Tech:** Sujan Subedi (Live Sound Mixing & System Tuning Engineer; Alumnus of A.R. Rahman's KM Music Conservatory, Chennai)
- **Primary Use Cases:** Live concert sound reinforcement, FOH mixing calibration, delay tower time alignment, subwoofer array optimization, multi-zone venue tuning, RF coordination, audio pinout inspection.
- **Architectural Philosophy:** 100% offline-first. All DSP algorithms, FFT transformations, and acoustic formulas execute client-side via native Web Audio API and JavaScript without requiring active internet connectivity inside concrete venue basements, arena backstages, or remote outdoor festival grounds.

---

## 2. Core Engineering Tools & Physical Formulas

### 2.1 Acoustic Auto-Ping Delay Finder
- **URL:** https://www.soundengg.com/app.html?view=delay
- **Function:** One-microphone acoustic time-alignment system for synchronizing primary PA line arrays with delay towers, front-fills, under-balcony fills, and outfills.
- **Physics & Math:**
  - Speed of sound compensated for ambient venue temperature:
    $$c \approx 331.3 + (0.606 \times T^\circ\text{C}) \text{ [m/s]}$$
  - Propagation delay calculation:
    $$\Delta t = \frac{\Delta d}{c} \times 1000 \text{ [ms]}$$
  - Synthesized impulse / acoustic ping emitted from sound system; single measurement microphone captures direct sound arrival.
  - Cross-correlation analysis detects initial wavefront arrival time with sub-millisecond precision, calculating exact required electronic DSP delay setting.

### 2.2 1/24-Octave Lab-Grade Real-Time Analyzer (RTA)
- **URL:** https://www.soundengg.com/app.html?view=rta
- **Function:** Real-time acoustic frequency spectrum visualizer and diagnostic analyzer.
- **Technical Specifications:**
  - Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) sizes: 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384 samples.
  - Scientific windowing functions:
    - **Hann (Hanning):** General acoustic analysis, low spectral leakage.
    - **Hamming:** Narrow main lobe for isolating distinct spectral peaks.
    - **Blackman-Harris (4-term):** High side-lobe suppression (>92 dB) for measuring wide dynamic ranges.
    - **Flat-Top:** Exact amplitude level precision for sound level calibration.
    - **Rectangular:** Uniform weighting for transient and impulse response analysis.
  - Frequency Fractional Octave Grouping: 1/1 octave (10 ISO bands), 1/3 octave (31 ISO bands), 1/6 octave (61 bands), 1/12 octave, 1/24 octave (240+ bands).
  - Multi-Trace Capture: Up to 4 real-time trace memories (Live, Reference A, Reference B, Difference).
  - Telemetry Export: High-resolution PNG spectrum snapshots and raw CSV amplitude-frequency datasets.

### 2.3 Ear Training Laboratory
- **URL:** https://www.soundengg.com/app.html?view=eartraining
- **Function:** Critical listening training for sound technicians to rapidly identify frequency anomalies and feedback nodes during live events.
- **Technical Specifications:**
  - Modes: 1/1 Octave, 1/3 Octave ISO 266 standard center frequencies, and advanced 1/6 Octave micro-bands.
  - Audio Sources: Synthesized pink noise or custom user audio track upload via Web Audio API.
  - Boost/Cut Parameters: $\pm 3\text{ dB}, \pm 6\text{ dB}, \pm 9\text{ dB}, \pm 12\text{ dB}$ with adjustable parametric filter Q factor.

### 2.4 Calibrated Signal Generator
- **URL:** https://www.soundengg.com/app.html?view=signalgen
- **Function:** Precision reference audio generator for system gain structure verification, transducer continuity, and room mode excitation.
- **Signals Generated:**
  - Pure Sine Waves: Variable from $20\text{ Hz}$ to $20,000\text{ Hz}$ with harmonic distortion $<0.01\%$.
  - Pink Noise: Filtered $1/f$ spectral slope (-3 dB/octave) for balanced acoustic energy per fractional octave.
  - White Noise: Flat power spectral density (equal energy per Hertz).
  - Logarithmic Frequency Sweep: Continuous linear-phase sweep from $20\text{ Hz}$ to $20\text{ kHz}$.
  - Polarity Verification Pulse: Asymmetric directional waveform for verifying speaker cone push/pull polarity.
  - 1.0 kHz FOH Calibration Tone: Constant 0 dBu / -18 dBFS reference pulse.

### 2.5 Audio Pinouts & Wire Continuity Reference
- **URL:** https://www.soundengg.com/app.html?view=pinouts
- **Function:** Instant interactive schematics and wire color codes for professional audio, lighting, and stage network connectors.
- **Connectors Covered:**
  - **XLR 3-Pin Balanced Audio:** Pin 1 = Shield/Ground, Pin 2 = Hot (+), Pin 3 = Cold (-).
  - **XLR 5-Pin DMX512:** Pin 1 = Shield, Pin 2 = Data 1 (-), Pin 3 = Data 1 (+), Pin 4 = Data 2 (-), Pin 5 = Data 2 (+).
  - **Speakon NL2 / NL4 / NL8:** Speaker drive assignments (NL4: 1+/1- Sub/Low, 2+/2- Mid/High).
  - **RJ45 EtherCON:** T568A and T568B pinouts for Dante, Ravenna, AES50, and AVB digital stage snakes.
  - **DB25 TASCAM Standard:** 8-channel balanced audio multipin pinout.
  - **AES72 (Category Snake):** 4 balanced audio channels over standard Cat5e/6 shielded twisted-pair cable.
  - **TRS 1/4" & 3.5mm:** Tip = Hot (+), Ring = Cold (-), Sleeve = Ground/Shield.

### 2.6 Speaker Impedance & Cable Loss Calculator
- **URL:** https://www.soundengg.com/app.html?view=impedance
- **Function:** Loudspeaker load analysis and transmission line loss calculation.
- **Formulas:**
  - Series Impedance: $Z_{\text{total}} = Z_1 + Z_2 + \dots + Z_n$
  - Parallel Impedance: $\frac{1}{Z_{\text{total}}} = \frac{1}{Z_1} + \frac{1}{Z_2} + \dots + \frac{1}{Z_n}$
  - Cable Resistance: $R_{\text{cable}} = 2 \times \frac{\rho \times L}{A}$ (copper resistivity $\rho \approx 1.68 \times 10^{-8} \ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$)
  - Effective Damping Factor: $DF_{\text{eff}} = \frac{Z_{\text{load}}}{\frac{Z_{\text{load}}}{DF_{\text{amp}}} + R_{\text{cable}}}$
  - Transmission dB Loss: $\text{Loss (dB)} = 20 \log_{10}\left(\frac{Z_{\text{load}}}{Z_{\text{load}} + R_{\text{cable}}}\right)$

### 2.7 Live BPM Tap Tempo Delay Sync
- **URL:** https://www.soundengg.com/app.html?view=taptempo
- **Function:** Tempo calculation and delay subdivision sync for hardware and software time-based FX units.
- **Subdivisions Computed:** Quarter note ($60,000 / \text{BPM}$ ms), Eighth note, Dotted eighth ($1.5 \times \text{eighth}$), Sixteenth note, Triplets, and LFO modulation Hz rate ($\text{BPM} / 60$).

### 2.8 Subwoofer Array Calculator
- **URL:** https://www.soundengg.com/app.html?view=subcalc
- **Function:** Geometric layout and delay offsets for broadside and end-fire subwoofer configurations.
- **Acoustic Constraints:**
  - Maximum broadside center-to-center spacing: $d \le \frac{\lambda_{\text{crossover}}}{2} = \frac{c}{2 \times f_{\text{upper}}}$ to avoid lobing and spatial aliasing.
  - End-fire inter-element electronic delay: $\Delta t = \frac{d}{c} \times 1000$ ms.
